behavioral_rules.rule: No Scope Expansion or Silently Invented Logic
behavioral_rules.detail: Distinguish between source requirements, approved technical decisions, technical metadata, and undefined items. Mark missing rules as UNDEFINED_BY_SOURCE.
Do NOT attempt to fix or improve Chapter 1 requirements or business boundaries (e.g. adding offline sync, extra roles, or automated refunds).
Do NOT introduce JS frameworks (React, Vue, Angular), CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Bootstrap), or unapproved backend platforms. Use vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and ES6+ JS.
Review shared contracts before coding. Keep edits tightly constrained to target files for the assigned task without opportunistic refactoring.
Ensure writes to Inventory Movement, Payment Transaction, and Audit Trail entities are strictly append-only. Never rewrite transaction snapshots.
